content.short: Juice Finance is a cross-margin DeFi protocol on Blast designed to maximize yield and reward farming.
content.description:
Juice Finance is a high-performance cross-margin decentralized finance protocol built natively on the Blast Layer 2 network. It is specifically engineered to maximize capital efficiency for users by providing leveraged yield farming opportunities. Borrowers can access up to 3x leverage on their collateral—including ETH, WETH, and USDB—to deploy into a curated selection of vetted Blast dApps, such as Thruster and Hyperlock, significantly amplifying their potential returns.

Deeply integrated with the Blast ecosystem, Juice Finance is optimized to help users simultaneously accumulate Blast Points, Blast Gold, and other protocol-specific rewards. The platform focuses on providing a seamless and professional-grade experience for sophisticated DeFi participants who seek to optimize their yield strategies. Through its robust liquidation framework and transparent on-chain execution, Juice Finance serves as a vital multiplier for liquidity and engagement within the rapidly growing Blast ecosystem.
content.meta: Juice Finance provides leveraged yield farming and reward optimization for the Blast Layer 2 network.
